statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); five_reset=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.resets_at // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); week_reset=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.resets_at // empty'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty'); branch=""; if [ -n "$dir" ]; then branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$branch" ] && branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$dir" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); fi; fiveseg=""; if [ -n "$five" ]; then fivepct=$(printf '%.0f' "$five"); fivetext="5h:${fivepct}%"; if [ -n "$five_reset" ]; then resetstr=$(date -r "$five_reset" +%H:%M 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$resetstr" ] && fivetext="$fivetext->$resetstr"; fi; if [ "$fivepct" -ge 90 ]; then fivecolor='\033[1;31m'; elif [ "$fivepct" -ge 70 ]; then fivecolor='\033[33m'; else fivecolor='\033[2m'; fi; fiveseg=$(printf "${fivecolor}%s\033[0m" "$fivetext"); fi; weekseg=""; if [ -n "$week" ]; then weekpct=$(printf '%.0f' "$week"); weektext="7d:${weekpct}%"; if [ -n "$week_reset" ]; then weekresetstr=$(date -r "$week_reset" '+%a %H:%M' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$weekresetstr" ] && weektext="$weektext->$weekresetstr"; fi; if [ "$weekpct" -ge 90 ]; then weekcolor='\033[1;31m'; elif [ "$weekpct" -ge 70 ]; then weekcolor='\033[33m'; else weekcolor='\033[2m'; fi; weekseg=$(printf "${weekcolor}%s\033[0m" "$weektext"); fi; branchseg=""; [ -n "$branch" ] && branchseg=$(printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m' "$branch"); ctxseg=""; [ -n "$ctx" ] && ctxseg=$(printf '\033[2mctx:%s%%\033[0m' "$(printf '%.0f' "$ctx")"); modelseg=""; [ -n "$model" ] && modelseg=$(printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m' "$model"); output="$branchseg"; [ -n "$fiveseg" ] && output="${output:+$output }$fiveseg"; [ -n "$weekseg" ] && output="${output:+$output }$weekseg"; [ -n "$ctxseg" ] && output="${output:+$output }$ctxseg"; [ -n "$modelseg" ] && output="${output:+$output }$modelseg"; printf '%s' "$output"
